0.gpu_models: RTX 3050 A 4 GB; YOLO detected 4 people; SmolVLM captioned image on CUDA; measurements in docs/gpu-smoke.md

1.chat: eval.test_chatbot on 200 synthetic events: 20/20 saved questions matched expected rows; DROP, UPDATE, and DELETE all rejected; fixture intact.
1.ui: User verified local Streamlit dashboard: person_down category filter shows the event; camera-1 selection retains its matching event; chatbot query 'show person down events' returns 1 matching row (screenshots supplied 2026-10-16).
1.merge: Local main checkout: only branch is main; requirements check and ingest/chatbot/event-rule/pipeline tests pass; Streamlit UI interaction was verified by user screenshot; real-video pipeline produced a SQLite event and keyframe.
1.vision: YOLO + ByteTrack on 33.2-second clip at 2 FPS: 67 sampled frames (0.0-33.0 s); primary person track ID 1 present in all 67 samples with no gaps; 1.84 detected people/sample average. Person-down labels: alerts matched 2/3 clear positive clips (first 30s clip and snow slip clip hit; icy-walk slip clip missed). Logs: data/videos/phase1_user_33s_tracks.jsonl and per-clip tracks.

2.event: Ran vision.run_pipeline on the labeled 30-second fall clip at 2 FPS on the main RTX 3050 laptop. It finished in under clip duration, wrote two person_down events to data/events.db, saved both JPEG keyframes, and generated SmolVLM captions from those frames; keyframes reviewed for event match.
2.chat: chatbot.chat.ask('Show person down events') returned all 5 stored events, including both phase2-demo and both phase2-refresh real-video events; each new event has a saved keyframe path (2026-10-16).
2.dashboard: With Auto-refresh (5 s) checked in the existing localhost:8501 dashboard, ran the labeled clip for camera phase2-refresh; the page changed from 3 to 5 events and displayed both new person_down rows and keyframes without a manual reload (2026-10-16).

3.categories: For this build, person_down is the sole kept category. Existing labeled-positive check detected 2/3 clips (first 30-second demo and snow-slip; missed icy-walk slip). README documents crowd cut because the eight-person rule flags an ordinary queue (v006), fighting cut because no classifier detects the v001/v003/v011/w001 altercation examples, and tailgating/suspicious cut because no classifier and agreed labeled test set are available. See eval/phase3_baseline.md. This is a build-scope decision; false-alarm performance remains a separate failed check (2026-10-16).
3.cameras: Replayed two supplied AVI sources sequentially through the video pipeline as camera IDs v006 and v001. After fixing camera-ID parsing, ask('Show events from camera v006') returned only its one crowd event, and ask('Show events from camera v001') returned only its two events. eval.test_chatbot now has regression coverage for nonstandard camera IDs. This verifies simulated-source filtering, not simultaneous multi-camera load (2026-10-16).
3.chat: eval.test_real_chatbot scored the fixed eval/phase3_real_chat_questions.csv against captured video-event rows, excluding the old mock; 25/25 question results matched expected category/camera/confidence/limit filters. The test works on a temporary DB copy and leaves the shared event DB unchanged (2026-10-16).
3.stability: Completed 600-second local replay of the same 30-second fall clip at 640x360 and 2 FPS with YOLO + ByteTrack, --no-vlm: pipeline exited 0 and processed through 590s without crashing, creating 21 events. Replay is a repeated scene (not varied/live footage), and processing ran faster than real time; not evidence for false-alarm performance, real-time throughput, or all-features stability (2026-10-16).
